source: apasdechien (note 87 ; vue à hauteur de chien, sans chien, sections notées 4-5 : figures et ouverture ; image « Ville » hors contexte), maison-ptits-loups (nuit polaire sans animal), chasse-elegance (ni arme ni animal mort), junglegraffiti (tigre générique toléré), ice-attitude (insectes autorisés seulement).
style: Documentary-style natural photograph, camera placed close to the ground at an animal's eye level, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, gentle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, calm and inviting, realistic.
interdits: No animals unless the plan names a generic one, never the client's own animals, no dead animal, no weapon, no cage, no leash held by a visible person, no recognizable person.
evite: Évite de générer les animaux du client (ils viennent des vraies photos) : le monde vu à leur hauteur, sentiers, terrains et matières, sans animal.

404.consigne: An empty path forking in two directions in a misty wood, seen at ground level, a single ball resting in the grass at the fork, soft light, a gentle touch of humour, no animals.

ouverture.consigne: A quiet earthy path through {sujet}, early morning, the path leading gently into the distance, golden sunlight filtering through the canopy and creating dappled light on the ground, fallen leaves in the foreground in sharp focus, soft mist, no animals.
ouverture.evite: Le chien généré à la place des vrais.

section-fond.consigne: Wide cinematic shot of a silent forest covered in deep fresh snow at night, a soft glow above the treeline, gentle snowfall, no animals, no people.

scene-metier.consigne: {sujet} seen from below at ground level, forest background softly blurred, warm side light, like a natural obstacle course, no animals, no people.
scene-metier.evite: L'animal en action, aux pattes souvent déformées.

lieu.consigne: Open countryside in {lieu} seen from about 30 cm above the ground, a meadow edge and a hedgerow, soft light, no buildings, no people, no animals, an atmospheric mood image, not a specific real place.
lieu.source: apasdechien terrains (forêt, lac, campagne) ; leçon de l'image « Ville » hors contexte

texture.consigne: Close-up of {matieres} on the forest floor after rain, moss, fallen leaves and droplets, soft diffused light, filling the whole frame.

portrait-generique.consigne: A walker seen from behind and far away on a forest path, slightly out of focus, legs and back only, no face, no animal in the frame.
